explanation: Runs the system-wide upgrade script to fetch and install Fedora updates.
command: kitty sysupdate

explanation: Launches the interactive dotfiles synchronization and backup management CLI dashboard.
command: kitty ~/dotfiles/sync.sh

explanation: Initializes the Waydroid Android container within a scaled Gamescope window for gaming/apps.
command: waydroid-gamescope

explanation: Cycles through cooling fan profiles (Silent, Balanced, Performance) to manage heat and battery.
command: toggle-fan-profile

explanation: Sets the maximum threshold for battery charging to prolong hardware lifespan.
command: kitty charge-limit

explanation: Checks for and installs updates for all Flatpak user and system applications.
command: kitty sh -c 'flatpak update; echo; read -p "Press Enter to exit..."'

explanation: Queries the tuned service to display the currently active system power profile.
command: kitty sh -c 'tuned-adm active; echo; read -p "Press Enter to exit..."'

explanation: Kills and restarts the Noctalia top bar, notification overlays, and workspace overview.
command: quickshell kill -c overview; quickshell kill -c noctalia-shell; sleep 0.5; quickshell -c overview -d; quickshell -c noctalia-shell -d

explanation: Restarts pipewire and wireplumber user systemd services to fix broken audio/sound.
command: systemctl --user restart pipewire wireplumber

explanation: Kills and terminates all running Waydroid android container sessions to fix freezes.
command: waydroid session stop

explanation: Reloads Hyprland compositor settings, window rules, and keybindings without logging out.
command: hyprctl reload

explanation: Restarts the system network daemon to troubleshoot Wi-Fi/Ethernet connectivity (requires sudo).
command: sudo systemctl restart NetworkManager

explanation: Launches the btop terminal system monitor to track CPU, memory, disks, and processes.
command: kitty btop

explanation: Shows errors and warnings from the system log for the current boot.
command: kitty sh -c 'journalctl -p 3 -xb; echo; read -p "Press Enter to exit..."'

explanation: Removes unused flatpak runtimes to free up disk space.
command: kitty sh -c 'flatpak uninstall --unused; echo; read -p "Press Enter to exit..."'

explanation: Displays disk space utilization for all mounted filesystems.
command: kitty sh -c 'df -h; echo; read -p "Press Enter to exit..."'

explanation: Displays NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4050 health, driver version, temps, VRAM usage, and active processes.
command: kitty sh -c '~/.local/bin/gpu-status; echo; read -p "Press Enter to exit..."'

explanation: Launches Blender with NVIDIA PRIME GPU offloading for fast CUDA Cycles and EEVEE rendering.
command: prime-run blender

explanation: Monitors real-time NVIDIA GPU clock speeds, power draw, temperature, and process allocations.
command: kitty sh -c 'nvidia-smi; echo; read -p "Press Enter to exit..."'

explanation: Sets GPU to Hybrid Optimus mode (Intel for display, NVIDIA for heavy 3D/AI). Reboot required.
command: kitty sh -c 'pkexec envycontrol --switch hybrid && echo "Set to HYBRID mode — please reboot to apply."; echo; read -p "Press Enter to exit..."'

explanation: Sets GPU to Dedicated NVIDIA-only mode for maximum performance in all apps. Reboot required.
command: kitty sh -c 'pkexec envycontrol --switch nvidia && echo "Set to NVIDIA-only mode — please reboot to apply."; echo; read -p "Press Enter to exit..."'

explanation: Disables NVIDIA GPU to run exclusively on Intel UHD Graphics for maximum battery life. Reboot required.
command: kitty sh -c 'pkexec envycontrol --switch integrated && echo "Set to INTEGRATED mode — please reboot to apply."; echo; read -p "Press Enter to exit..."'

explanation: Runs a quick Python test to verify PyTorch detects CUDA and the NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4050.
command: kitty sh -c 'python3 -c "import torch; print(\"CUDA Available:\", torch.cuda.is_available()); print(\"GPU Device:\", torch.cuda.get_device_name(0) if torch.cuda.is_available() else \"N/A\")" 2>/dev/null || echo "PyTorch not found in current environment"; echo; read -p "Press Enter to exit..."'
